signal.causality: Use only prior 90 realized funding rates through t-1. Current-boundary funding is excluded from the state signal; an existing position receives it before exit/re-anchor, while a new entry receives none.

riskControl.reanchorAction: Close and immediately reopen at full modeled costs after 180 active boundaries or when mark notional reaches 25% of current sleeve equity, unless funding exit triggers first.

antiRescueRule: After first Trial 25 development economic output, no scientific parameter or gate may change under Trial 25.
